content.title: In Case of an Emergency - By P.A
content.body:
If you find yourself lost with no basic tools:
      §l1. §rFind §oFlint §rinside §oGravel
      §l2. §rGet §oSticks §rfrom §oLeaves
      §l3. §rCraft a §oFlint Saw
      §l4. §rGather §oWood §rwith the saw
      §l5. §rMake a §oCrafting Table 
      §l6. §rCraft a §oFlint Pickaxe
    Note: Try to test which ores can be harvested with a stone/iron pickaxe
